# Shenyang Kaixin Technology Co., Ltd.

> Shenyang Kaixin Technology Co., Ltd. is a manufacturer and OEM/ODM partner for
> eco-friendly rice husk (plant fiber) dinnerware, based in Shenyang, China, in
> operation since 2016. Our products are BPA-free, plastic-free and reusable, and
> are supplied to food service, catering, retail and hospitality buyers worldwide.
> We offer full OEM/ODM customization including client logo, colour and packaging.

Kaixin is a B2B supplier, not a retailer. There is no online checkout and no
consumer pricing. Buyers are importers, distributors, restaurant and cafe chains,
catering companies, and private-label brands. Inquiries are handled through the
contact form and answered by a sales team; the typical engagement is a quotation
followed by sample confirmation and container-load production.

This site covers the rice husk dinnerware range and buying guidance. It does not
cover item pricing lists, logistics rates, or third-party product reviews.

- [Screw-thread round plate](https://www.kaixin-tableware.com/products/screw-thread-round-plate.html): Round plate with a moulded screw-thread rim detail.
- [Chopping board](https://www.kaixin-tableware.com/products/chopping-board.html): Rice husk cutting board, a plastic chopping board alternative.
- [Colored chopping board](https://www.kaixin-tableware.com/products/colored-chopping-board.html): Colour-coded chopping board for kitchen hygiene zoning.
- [Rolling pin](https://www.kaixin-tableware.com/products/rolling-pin.html): Rice husk rolling pin for dough work.
- [Coffee cup](https://www.kaixin-tableware.com/products/coffee-cup.html): Rice husk coffee cup for cafes and takeaway service.
